name: setup
description: Read this first, before the reeval skill, whenever you're asked to set up, install, add, try or get started with reeval (the eval runner for coding agents), in a project or an empty directory, including "set up reeval here" and "add evals". It detects what's set up, asks what to evaluate, installs reeval, writes one to three small evals that show its value (a skill with and without, when the project has skills), runs `reeval doctor` for keys and Docker, and explains the results.
